newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices lose previous gains.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices lose previous gains.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Friday lost previous gains, falling to 1,185/1,186 rupees per quintal from 1,195/1,196 rupees on speculative selling, dealers said.
"Sliding prices in export deals as well as higher new crop arrivals prompted liquidation of long positions," one dealer said.

Export deals for 400/500 tonnes of castoroil were done at $690 per tonne against $710 last week. March delivery remained untraded as most of the outstanding positions were shifted to June delivery, dealers said.
Groundnut oil was steady at 339/340 rupees per 10 kg amid limited arrivals of 40/50 tonnes but physical buying was slow.
Rajkot spot oil slid by 2/3 rupees to 512/513 rupees per 15 kg.
Imported palm oil in Bombay rose by 1/2 rupees to 285 rupees per 10 kg in the absence of fresh offerings by importers, one dealer said.
There are also fears in the trade that the government may raise import duty in next week's budget, dealers said.
